proposedBy: Claude Code (technical provider) on owner Directive Maître V14.4, 2026-11-22
authorizationRequired: human PROPOSED -> AUTHORIZED before any EXECUTING
objective: Compose the EXISTING components into ONE traced, deterministic chain, run OFFLINE on already-recorded real data: knowledge-acquisition.acquire(REAL_CYCLE) → memory-trust-gate admission (provenance/freshness/confidence) → improvement experiment record → odg-improvement-chain.run() which consumes odg-sandbox-integration-gate.decide() → evidence trace; with a REAL consumer (odg-cto-dashboard surface) and a reuse proof (a second run retrieves the admitted knowledge instead of re-acquiring).
scope: Pure composition module + test + a read-only run script. NO egress (REAL_CYCLE = records consulted 2026-11-16 under the then-valid V141 grant), NO execution of integrations, NO deploy, NO métier, NO register edits.
write_set: runtime/core/odg-cto-dashboard.ts (one read-only indicator line consuming the chain trace)
package.json (append the new test to test:report only)
invariants: reuse only: odg-knowledge-acquisition, memory-trust-gate, odg-improvement-chain, odg-sandbox-integration-gate, odg-radar-source-provenance — no second radar/memory/gate/orchestrator
fail-closed: missing provenance/date ⇒ NOT admitted; INACCESSIBLE sources stay recorded as such
fact ≠ hypothesis ≠ simulation preserved end-to-end; REAL_CYCLE labelled REAL_RECORDED (not live)
INTEGRATE ⇒ MERGE_ELIGIBLE decision only, never an applied change
deterministic given injected nowEpochMs; no network, no fs writes except the evidence file via the run script
acceptance_criteria: test: admitted knowledge items carry url+consultedDate+claimType+corroboration; 403 sources excluded with reason
test: chain trace has every stage with input/output hashes; verdict comes from sandbox-integration-gate.decide
test: second run REUSES admitted knowledge (retrieved count > 0, re-acquired = 0) — reuse proof
odg-cto-dashboard indicator consumes the trace (real consumer); census marks module CONNECTED
tsc + build:runtime + targeted tests + full test:report no new failure vs baseline (832/835, 2 known pre-existing)
independent inspection by a separate agent: ACCEPT
stop_conditions: any need for egress, new grant, credential, or system change
a hard-register or V12.4 file would change
a new failing test not explainable as pre-existing
rollback: single PR; revert the merge commit (all files additive except one dashboard line and one test:report entry)
evidence_required: census before/after for the new module
measurement: before/after: retrieved-vs-reacquired knowledge on run 2; stage latencies p50/p95 over N=20 deterministic runs; NO quality claim beyond the recorded sample (n=4 sources, 2 retrieved) — real-world performance stays NOT_MEASURED
step2_not_in_scope: live Radar collection — requires an ACCEPTED unexpired grant (V371 grant PROPOSED)
